title: Pete Masarini, the drummer with no fingers, and his band
summary: He recalls drummer Pete Masarini, who played with finger stumps, and others in that band including Joe Pelletti, Joe Holbin and a clarinetist around 1912-13.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
